description_text:
|| Cutted Wood Stacks ||
Cutted Wood Stacks AAA PBR Game Ready Asset, is a high quality, low poly asset originally modeled in 3DS Max 2018.
The normal map was baked from a high poly model in Substance Painter 2020, making this product look very detailed without using many polygons. This product is intended for game/real time/ usage. This model is not intended for subdivision.The polycount is similar to the modern FPS AAA games.
The renders and wireframes were done in Marmoset Toolbag 3. (The triangulation of the the mesh topology is caused by Marmoset).
||SPECS||
Low Poly Model:
Includes: .obj, .max, .fbx, .3ds files.
.obj,.fbx and .3ds versions exported from 3ds Max 2018 . 
The individual planks used to create the stacks are included.
An Unreal Engine 4 project is also included with textures. Ready to be used in your game.
An Unity package is also available. 
Substance Painter workfile is included.
|| Geometry ||
Stack 1:
2.054 Total Polys
1.896 Total Verts
3.476 Total Tris
Stack 2:
2.600 Total Polys
2.400 Total Verts
4.400 Total Tris
Stack 3:
660 Total Polys
360 Total Verts
660 Total Tris
Model unwrapped manually to make most efficient use of the UV space.
Model scaled to approximate real world size. All materials and objects named appropriately.
Tested in Marmoset Toolbag 3 (see renders).
No special plug-ins needed to use this product.
|| Textures ||
Textures for Unity 5 and Unreal Engine 4 can be downloaded.
Textures in .targa format:
2k texture set. -PBR Textures (Basecolor, ambient occlusion, metallic, roughness, normal) -Unreal Textures (Basecolor,Normal, Occlusion/Roughness/Metallic) -Unity Textures (Albedo/Transparency, Metallic/Smoothness, Normal)

description_text: The sculpture of the Yellow River Mother is composed of a mother and a baby boy. They respectively symbolize the mother of the Yellow River, who nurtures the Chinese nation and never gives up, and the happy and thriving descendants of China. The sculpture has a simple composition and profound meaning, reflecting the ancient history and culture of Gansu.The material selection for the sculpture of the Yellow River Mother is ordinary granite, which can better express the color of the Yellow River and the skin color of the descendants of the Yellow River. At the same time, the rough texture of granite seems to tell the story of the vicissitudes and great changes experienced by the Chinese nation for thousands of years. The composition is concise and profound, symbolizing the mother of the Yellow River who nurtures the Chinese nation's endless vitality and indomitable spirit, as well as the happy and thriving descendants of China. The pedestal of the Yellow River Mother Statue is engraved with water ripples and fish patterns, originating from the primitive patterns of ancient painted pottery in Gansu Province, reflecting the long history and culture of Gansu. description_text:
Model created for educational/background purposes. The clouds and night-lights can be easily adjusted to your preference. A noise texture was used for the stars. Can be disabled in the node editor.
Model has 5 objects, each with a material with the same name as the object. The material contains the textures, if textures are missing just assign the right image textures. The scene also has a camera and light.
I didn't use a UV Map, I used texture coordination to assign all the textures. I used a bump map for the clouds and terrain.
Textures provided(jpg and png):
Earth: 8192 x 4096Bump: 21600 x 10800Clouds: 4096 x 2048Lights: 16384 x 8192Ocean Mask: 10800 x 5400
Formats provided:
.blend file
The model was created in Blender 2.78b, everything is already set up. To make things easier, move the texture files into the same folder the .blend file is, if by some chance the textures don't display, you just need to assign the textures to the correct nodes (tutorial included). 
The scene colour was set to black, you can move the sun lamp around to light the earth or simply change the scene colour.
All objects have the correct names with correct material names.
All objects scaled to 1,1,1 and rotation to 0,0,0Scene units is set to meters.The dimensions of the model is 20m x 20m. With a radius of 10m and diameter of 20m.

description_text:
A realistic looking ocean scene made in 3dsmax and Vray only. A nice ocean shader with some subsurface planes and Environmental Fog plus Depth of field set to go. 
Keep in mind that this scene only works if you have Vray plugin installed. The entire scene is made with VrayDisplacementMap. This is no complex scene with heavy surfaces or modeling plugins. Just couple of Planes displaced via material editor. To animate this scene all you need is to adjust Phase and Offset settings in materials. If you find complex scenes bothering and familiar with 3ds max, then you are good to go. 
(Sunrise and Daylight HDR's included)
Have fun!

description_text:
Hi-res 3d model of grass patches for green meadows.
The bundle contains 13 different grasspatches:  3x flat, 3x short, 3x long, 1x dead grass, 3x clumps
There are 9 bigger patches with a diameter of 50cm (20inches) but also 3 smaller clumps and a dead grass patch. 
Can be used for close up shots or as scatter objects on landscapes.When populated on landscapes the models are best used as instance or proxy because of the polycount (~20k quads per patch)

  - each model comes with 2K PBR textures (png), suitable for close up shots and animation

  - clean topology, mostly quads

  - carefully modelled to real world scale(centimeters)

  - materials and textures have unique and meaningful names

  - each model has proper unwrapped UVs (0-1 space).

Maya file has VRay Standard Materials (VRayMtl) assigned.Preview images rendered with VRay.
Two kinds of texture maps included:

  - Textures ready for V-Ray(diffuse, specular, glosiness), also suitable for most render enginges;

  - PBR metalness workflow (basecolor, metallic, roughness), ready for Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR) and other real-time apps.

description_text:
High-quality, highly optimized 3D model of a modern wooden sauna house / log cabin. This exterior architectural asset is perfectly tailored for professional outdoor environment rendering, suburban real estate presentations, cottage community layouts, and landscape design visualizations.
With a highly efficient mesh of only ~10k polygons and an incredibly lightweight file size (~3 MB), this model serves as an ideal background asset or standalone feature project. It delivers beautiful photorealistic wood aesthetics without slowing down your workstation's viewport or bloating heavy scene files.
Key Features & Specifications:

  - Optimized Mid-Poly Geometry: Only 10,312 polygons, making it perfect for rapid rendering and populating large-scale outdoor environments.

  - Photorealistic Shading: Fully textured with rustic wood and glass materials applied and configured.

  - Precision Setup: Completely built to accurate real-world scale using Millimeters (mm) system units.

  - Origin Centered: The asset is perfectly positioned at the center of the coordinates system (0,0,0).

  - Clean Architecture: Texture paths are fully stripped; meshes are manually unwrapped for a flawless finish.

  - Standard Workflow: No third-party plugins or external script tools are required to open or render.

Technical Details:

  - Polygons: 10,312

  - Vertices: 11,652

  - Native File Format: 3ds Max 2014 (with custom Corona Renderer materials configured).

  - Wide Compatibility Exchange Formats: OBJ (1.24 MB), FBX (659 KB), 3DS (766 KB).

  - Textures: All high-resolution image maps and materials are fully included in the package archive.

Cross-Platform Compatibility Note: The model is natively prepared for 3ds Max and fine-tuned for Corona Render. Thanks to the clean geometry and standard file exports, importing the universal exchange formats (.FBX, .OBJ, or .3DS) into Blender (Cycles/Eevee), Cinema 4D, SketchUp, ArchiCAD, or Lumion is highly seamless. Shaders may require simple re-assignment depending on your software of choice.
Enhance your Nordic or rustic country landscape scenes with this cozy backyard oasis. If you are satisfied with the asset quality, please leave a positive feedback — community-approved model! Check out my complete profile gallery for more high-quality furniture sets and architectural assets.

Outdoor Bench-1-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This is a medium detailed model of a bench for outdoor space,ready to drop into any scene or be used as a stand-alone prop.This model will make Visualization “alive” due to realism and attention to all details.Originally modeled at 3ds Max 2009 sp1. Final images rendered with VRay 1.5sp2There is no post-production at renders above.Material setup is included only in the V-Ray version, as per the preview images.Carefully detailed and cleanly structured objects.Fully detailed - texture maps.Just merge in your scene, check texture paths and hit render.Real world scale and exact proportions.Multiple file formats including 3ds Max scanline version.Studio setup is not included in any scene files.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------FEATURES-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* 'SMOOTH MODIFIER' and 'UVW MAPPING' options are not collapse in the scene file.* Professional quality model designed for ease of use - No cleaning up necessary,   just drop your model into the scene and start rendering.* UV's & textures fully applied. Il tempietto di San Pietro in Montorio, detto anche Tempietto del Bramante, è una piccola costruzione a pianta circolare posta al centro di uno dei cortili del convento di San Pietro in Montorio a Roma, sul colle Gianicolo; è situato in piazza di San Pietro in Montorio, 2.
Viene considerato uno degli esempi più significativi d'architettura rinascimentale, di cui esemplifica alcuni dei temi fondamentali, come la pianta centrale, la ripresa dell'architettura romana antica e la ricerca proporzionale e geometrica nel rapporto tra le parti.
The small temple of San Pietro in Montorio, also called Tempietto del Bramante, is a small building with a circular plan located in the center of one of the courtyards of the convent of San Pietro in Montorio in Rome, on the Janiculum hill; it is located in piazza di San Pietro in Montorio, 2.
One of the most beautiful examples of Renaissance architecture, the revival of ancient Roman architecture. Is very important the research of the proportion between geometries in the relationship with the context.

The valknut is a symbol consisting of three interlocked triangles. It appears on a variety of objects from the archaeological record of the ancient Germanic peoples. The term valknut is derived from the modern era, and the term or terms used to refer to the symbol during its historical employment is unknown.
Scholars have proposed a variety of explanations for the symbol, sometimes associating it with the god Odin, and it has been compared to the three-horned symbol found on the 9th-century Snoldelev Stone, to which it may be related.

The valknut appears on a wide variety of objects found in areas inhabited by the Germanic peoples. The symbol is prominently featured on the Nene River Ring, an Anglo-Saxon gold finger ring dated to around the 8th to 9th centuries.  A wooden bed in the Viking Age Oseberg Ship buried near Tønsberg, Norway features a carving of the symbol on an ornately stylized bedpost and the Oseberg tapestry fragments, a partially preserved tapestry found within the ship burial, also features the symbol.Additionally, the valknut appears prominently on two picture stones from Gotland, Sweden: the Stora Hammars I stone and the Tängelgårda stone.
The historically attested instances of the symbol appear in two traditional, topologically distinct, forms. The symbol appears in unicursal form, topologically a trefoil knot also seen in the triquetra. This unicursal form is found, for example, on the Tängelgårda stone. The symbol also appears in tricursal form, consisting of three linked triangles, topologically equivalent to the Borromean rings. This tricursal form can be seen on one of the Stora Hammars stones, as well as upon the Nene River Ring, and on the Oseberg ship bed post. Although other forms are topologically possible, these are the only attested forms found so far.

This 3D model is not just a visual treat but also a symbol of Islamic culture and heritage, making it an ideal addition to your collection for religious celebrations, cultural presentations, or any project that seeks to capture the essence of Islamic beauty and faith.
Please contact me if you have any issues with the model. I will do my best to fix any problems.
Thanks -Adil Farhan

description_text:
The Taj Mahal Agra India
The Taj Mahal  is a mausoleum-mosque located in Agra, India, on the banks of the Yamuna River (architects, probably, Ustad Isa and others). It was built by order of the padishah of the Mughal Empire Shah Jahan I, in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal, who died giving birth to her fourteenth child. Futuristic Parametric Pavilion – Organic Mesh Canopy DesignThe scene was prepared in 3ds max 2023 and rendered with corona 9.
HDR was not used in the renders. The visible sky was created with Corona Sky.The 3dsmax file named 2023 is used for modeling and rendering.   - 3ds max 2021 and 2018 files are compatible with corona 5.

  - In the fbx file, all models except the lights and the human model are available with the smooth modifier.

  - In the obj file, all models except the lights and the human model are in their final state.

  - UVmaps of the models have not been processed.So Unwrap UVW has not been done.

This model is suitable for use in broadcast, advertising, design visualization, real-time, video game etc.

Render setup is included.

|| GENERAL ||

Model is built to real-world scale(the unit system is metric). 
No third-party renderer or plug-ins needed.

|| ADDITIONAL NOTES ||

description_text:
Photo-realistic 3d model of a spruce tree trunk perfect for every use-case ranging from games, film or animation. The model is available in four different levels of detail and the texture maps scale up to 16k. All meshes are uv-mapped and have a clean mesh (mainly quads). The tree trunk also has real world scale.
Note that the Blender file to render the preview images is included, too.
Meshes

  - lod0 (281k vertices)

  - lod1 (46k vertices)

  - lod2 (9k vertices)

  - lod3 (2.5k vertices)

All meshes are available in the following formats

  - .blend

  - .fbx

  - .glb

  - .obj + .mtl

All textures are available in the following resolutions

  - diffuse_16k.jpg

  - normal_16k.jpg

  - ao_16k.jpg

  - diffuse_8k.jpg

  - normal_8k.jpg

  - ao_8k.jpg

  - diffuse_4k.jpg

  - normal_4k.jpg

  - ao_4k.jpg

Please contact me personally if you are interested in the raw files (mesh with 12 million vertices and the raw texture maps)
Still questions?
Feel free to contact me at any time! You can find contact information on my website https://flolu.com

description_text:
High-quality, detailed 3D model of a futuristic building, ideal for your scenes/concepts. Ideal for futuristic city skylines but also detailed enough for closer shots. This model is based on my own concept, it's modeled in 3dsmax. 
IMPORTANT NOTICE - 3dsmax is native software for this model. You can use it in any other 3D software as well, but you'll need to create shaders/materials with provided textures. Materials I created are fairly simple and I didn't use many textures at all, mostly procedural shaders and colors. There is a marmoset preview for you to inspect the geometry.
This model has day and night version (Corona renderer). You just need to turn on and off the self-illumination slot in Corona material.
Downloadable content:

  - NATIVE 3dsmax files (versions 2023 and 2020) - Corona material-ready

  - 3dsmax files - Vray material-ready scene. Converted and updated materials from Corona to Vray 6

  - FBX file

  - OBJ file 

  - Blender scene (imported mesh only, shaders must be created manually)

  - Textures

If you have any questions, feel free to ask.

description_text:
This is detailed real-world size house made by professional architect from construction DWG drawings.

  - This model is suitable for visualization, AR/VR, real-time and game use, architecture, consulting, education

  - Units used: Centimeters

FORMATS

  - 
MAX - 3dsMax (V-Ray and Standard materials)

  - 
FBX, OBJ, DAE - Exchange Formats

  - 
UNITYPACKAGE - Unity 3D / request

  - 
BLEND - Blender / request

  - 
SKP - SketchUp  / request

GEOMETRY

  - Geometry is carefully tested for holes, flipped normals and overlapping polygons

  - Mesh is low-poly, allows you to easily build up the additional details, edit geometry

  - Shell Modifier applied for glass objects

  - Scene objects are organized by layers

  - All preview images are rendered with 3.20 V-Ray

  - Wire images done with VrayLightMtl + VrayDirt for geometry test

  - Camera and lights are included - product is ready to render out-of-the-box

MATERIALS

  - This model contains both V-Ray and Standard materials

  - JPG textures comes in separate archive

ADDITIONAL NOTES
  - No third-party plug-ins needed

The Super Chief was one of the named passenger trains and flagship of the Atchison Topeka and Santa Fe.  It was operated from 1936 until it ceased operations in 1971.  It claimed to be the train of the stars as many celbrities rode the train between Los Angleles and Chicago.  Super Cheif ran initially once weekly until 1938 and then twice weekly and daily after 1948.  It served gourmet meals on board to passegers.

Dear customer,
“The beauty of the nation” is a series of models of heads.
The model is made in the scale 1/35, it is ready for use in dioramas of the 35th scale. The detailing of the model is appropriate - the details are clearer and larger, which is typical for miniature objects.
This model is designed and prepared for printing.
For designers, the OBJ format is useful, which allows you to use the model as a spare part or base for your own project.
The project “The Beauty of the Nation” is based on the idea of showing the public that every nation, every race and every ethnic group has its own beauty and its own zest, which can be admired and inspired. We idolize beauty and extol it in all sources of realization available to us: be it a sculpture, a painting, poetry, music or cinema. Beauty, in spite of the differences in cultures and the views of the majority, proved that the boundaries, opinions and customs are alien to it. Beauty is an inspiration for contemplation, which entails the creation of even more beautiful things.
Sincerely Yours,
Svetlana

description_text:
Sculpted in Zbrush. The sculpture depicts Baden Powell, founder of the Boy Scouts, in his traditional garb
DescriptionLieutenant-General Robert Stephenson Smyth Baden-Powell, 1st Baron Baden-Powell, OM, GCMG, GCVO, KCB, DL; 22 February 1857 – 8 January 1941) was a British Army officer, writer, author of Scouting for Boys which was an inspiration for the Scout Movement, founder and first Chief Scout of The Boy Scouts Association and founder of the Girl Guides.
After having been educated at Charterhouse School in Surrey, Baden-Powell served in the British Army from 1876 until 1910 in India and Africa. In 1899, during the Second Boer War in South Africa, Baden-Powell successfully defended the town in the Siege of Mafeking. Several of his military books, written for military reconnaissance and scout training in his African years, were also read by boys. In 1907, he held a demonstration camp, the Brownsea Island Scout camp, which is now seen as the beginning of Scouting. Based on his earlier books, particularly Aids to Scouting, he wrote Scouting for Boys,published in 1908 by Sir Arthur Pearson, for boy readership. In 1910 Baden-Powell retired from the army and formed The Boy Scouts Association.
The first Scout Rally was held at The Crystal Palace in 1909, at which appeared a number of girls dressed in Scout uniform, who told Baden-Powell that they were the Girl Scouts, following which, in 1910, Baden-Powell and his sister Agnes Baden-Powell formed the Girl Guides from which the Girl Guides Movement grew. In 1912 he married Olave St Clair Soames. He gave guidance to the Scouting and Girl Guiding Movements until retiring in 1937. Baden-Powell lived his last years in Nyeri, Kenya, where he died and was buried in 1941.

description_text:
The Mikoyan Mig-35 (Russian: оян -35, NATO nickname: Fulcrum-F) is an advanced development of the MiG-29M/M2 and MiG-29K/KUB technologies. It is classified as a 4++ generation rovers by Mikoyan.[2] The first prototype of this aircraft is a modification of the aircraft that previously served as a demonstrator for the MiG-29M2. 10 prototypes have been built and are in the stage of extensive field testing.[3] The MiG-35 is now classified as a mid-range fighter due to its take-off weight, which is up to 30 percent higher than the previous prototype, which exceeds the criteria for a light aircraft classification.
The MiG company officially presented this aircraft at an international event at the Aero India airshow in 2007.[4] The MiG-35 was first made public when the Russian Minister of Defense, Sergey Ivanov, visited the MAPO-MIG engine manufacturing plant.[5] The one-seat version is called the MiG-35 and the two-seat version is called the MiG-35D. The fighter gets considerable upgrades in avionics and weapons systems, notably the AESA radar system (GCI) and allows the aircraft to carry out multi-role missions alone.

description_text:
During the early 1980s, the US Army began to formulate requirements for replacement of the helicopters then in service, which resulted in the launch of the Light Helicopter Experimental (LHX) program. Nearly a decade later, after refinement of requirements, evaluation of submissions, and rebranding of the program as the Light Helicopter (LH) program, during April 1991, the Army announced the selection of the Boeing – Sikorsky design team as the winner of the contest, shortly after which the contract for the construction of the prototype was awarded. Comanche will incorporate some advanced elements, such as stealth technology, and a number of never-before-tested design features. Operationally, it uses advanced sensors in its reconnaissance role, where it is intended to set targets for the AH-64 Apache. It is also armed with a single rotary cannon and can carry missiles and rockets in the internal bay and optionally on the stub wing for light attack duty.
Two RAH-66 prototypes were built and underwent flight testing between 1996 and 2004. On June 1, 2000, the program entered a $3.1 billion engineering and manufacturing development (EMD) phase. However, during 2002, the Comanche program underwent a major restructuring; the number of Comanche to be purchased was cut to 650. At that time, the total projected cost for the full production of Comanche in that amount was $26.9 billion. Since the late 1990s, the Government Accountability Office (GAO) has reported that it has serious doubts about the program, The Boeing-Sikorsky RAH-66 Comanche is an American stealth armed reconnaissance and attack helicopter designed for the United States Army. After decades of development, during 2004, the RAH-66 program was canceled before mass production began, of which nearly US$7 billion was spent on the program.observing that Comanche will spent nearly two-thirds of the entire Aviation budget in Fiscal Year 2008. Several government agencies have acted to reduce the number of Comanches ordered, but, as a consequence of the massive reduction in the number to be purchased, unit costs have soared.
On February 23, 2004, the US Army announced the termination of the Comanche program, stating that it had determined that the RAH-66 would require major upgrades to survive on the battlefield and that the service would instead direct the majority of its rotary system funds toward renovating attack helicopters, utilities, and existing reconnaissance. The Army also announced new plans to accelerate development of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), which can also perform the reconnaissance role intended for the Comanche, but with less risk. Since the cancellation of the program, both prototypes have been placed on public screens.

description_text:
THIS IS THE BEST LOOKING ALL-IN Organizer for CASCADIA board game THAT YOU CAN PRINT!Stay updated! Follow me on social media @ammedia3d for the latest news and new product releases!
FEATURESThis is a 3D printable inserts set for the board game CASCADIA (2021), designed to organize not only the base game, but absolutely EVERYTHING released up to 2024 — all expansions, mini-expansions, and promo cards included!
ALL-IN SUPPORT means this organizer has dedicated space for:

  - Kickstarter Promo Cards (2021)

  - Ecosystem Connections – Tantrum House Season 8 Promo Cards (2022)

  - Landmarks Expansion (2023)

  - Landmark Scoring Mini-Expansion (2024)

Thanks to the interlocking lids, you can store the box horizontally or vertically without any risk of components spilling out. Inserts also support sleeved cards.
This is the ultimate storage solution for Cascadia collectors and fans who want to keep everything perfectly organized in the original box — no compromises!

  - Easy to print, 100% support-free

  - They can be printed on ALL 3D printers with a minimum build volume of 180x180mm

  - They can be stored in either horizontal or vertical position

  - All boxes have an interlocking lid, no magnet required!

  - LayeredArt Lid for unique & decorative designs! (lids without decoration are also included)

  - Support sleeved cards

LAYERED-ART LIDSLayeredArt Lid: Introducing the amazing new LayeredArt lid! a LOOK-changer for your 3D printable organizer for CASCADIA board game! - These decorated lids take the aesthetics of your game to an epic level, creating unique, themed effects that will blow your friends' minds. Each lid is a work of art that transforms your gaming experience into something truly unique. These designs are created by switching filaments during the printing process, allowing for intricate patterns and designs. The best part? You can achieve this with any single-filament 3D printer! Detailed instructions are included, specifying the exact layer number for filament changes, making it easy for anyone to get amazing results.
LAYERED-ART WITH ANY 3D PRINTER !You can printing the LAYERED-ART LIDS with a normal 3D printer. Each colour is set to a different height to allow for filament changes USING M600 G-CODE OR PAUSE COMMAND. I've written an article on this topic: https://bit.ly/3DFE2Pz / - in the photos you can see a preview of the slicer, on the right you can see the color changes and their respective heights.
SCALE/DIMENSIONSPlease do not alter the dimensions of the file as this may make the model unprintable.
IMPORTANT INFOThe interlocks of the lids are designed with tolerances suitable for printing on standard home printers. All my inserts are tested using an old Ender 3 (first model). I recommend printing a single insert with its lid first to test the fit before proceeding with the full set. If the fit is too tight, your printer may need calibration. The total size of the organizer is 229x229x66mm. Although rare, slight variations in box sizes may occur due to differences in production, printing, or edition. This is my impression of a Greek amphitheatre (or amphitheater if you live in the USA), where plays and performances were shown. Often these were built into a natural hillside.
The model is a low poly game asset, with a number of PBR texture files that can be tuned in size to your liking. I added it more as an example than anything. Though, it might still come in handy for you.

description_text:
About Al Ghawanima Minaret
Al-Ghawanima minaret is the second of minarets and is located on the north-western corner of the noble sanctuary in 1297-98. It is the tallest minaret of Haram al-Sharif and was built by architecht named Qazi Sharaf al-Din al Khalili on the orders of Sultan Lajin. The minaret is almost completely made of stone except the wooden canopy over Muazzin’s balcony. Because of its firm structure, the Ghawanima minaret has been nearly untouched by earthquakes. The minaret is divided into several stories by stone molding and stalactite galleries. The first two stories are wider and form the base of the tower. The additional four stories are surmounted by a cylindrical drum and a bulbous dome. The stairway is externally located on the first two floors, but becomes an internal spiral structure from the third floor until it reaches the muezzin’s balcony.
I was inspired by the design, Its a AAA game ready PBR model use for AR/VR Mix Reality, Metaverse, Unity 3d & Unreal Engine projects, included texture with fbx + source file.

description_text:
This is a high quality low poly house.
This model is a game ready, ideal for games or real time system too.
It is a haunted halloween house, with some pumpkins, cobwebs an a coffin. Great for your halloween
party!
The house has an explorable first floor. You can put inside whatever you want, maybe a ghost to make
the atmosphere more scary!
The props (cobwebs, coffin, pumpkins) have a separate texture, so you can use them also in other
projects.
The house have and unique quality texture 2048x2048.
The different textures are provided in 4 different file format: .jpg .png .tga .bmp. 
The textures with the transparency like the cobweb's texture have an alpha jpg, and they already have
transparency in the png format.
The house has an unique texture to optimize the operations within the games, in this way there is
only one drawcall that improves a little the performance.
The unwrapping is not overlapping (except for the columns, in order to maintain high the quality).
The house without details has 737polys, 1519tris, 962verts, so it is also ideal for mobile games.
The house with details (cobwebs, pumpkins, coffin) has 3229polys, 6259tris, 3414verts, for more
complex games.
The model was made with 3d studio max 2010. The max file have 3 lights and 1 camera.
The archive "all_textures_only" contains all the textures with all the formats. It contains also a
psd file with the houe's texture divided in layers based on the subpoly (first_floor, second_floor,
roof and so on), that allow you to simply modify the texture.
Model's format: .Max .3Ds .Fbx .Obj.
Good quality, good price!
!!N.B. HHH means haunted halloween house.
Enjoy it!

description_text:
High-quality low-poly 3D model of U.S. School Bus. The Interior part is also modeled and textured but with less detail.
It is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
It can also be rendered in Blender (ex Cycles) or Vray as the model is equipped with detailed textures.
Model is built with great attention to details and realistic proportions with the correct geometry,
this way it is also good enough for close-ups.
Technical details:

  - 4096 x 4096 Diffuse and AO textures

  - 6244 Triangles

  - 3814 Polygons

  - 3773 Vertices

  - Model is correctly divided into main part and wheels.

  - Model completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

  - Pivot points are correctly placed to suit animation process.

  - Model scaled to approximate real world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials and textures are appropriately named.

Available file formats:

  - Blender files and example render scenes (Eevee studio setup and Cycles HDRI)

  - Blender files in 2 versions (packed and regular-unpacked)

  - Unity3D 2018.4 (.unitypackage)

  - Unreal Engine 4.27 (.uasset)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - 3ds Max 2018 (.max)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.gltf)

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx)

  - 3D Studio (.3ds)

  - Collada (.dae)

  - OBJ (.obj)

Additional Info:

  - Please feel free to contact me if you need any further information about this 3d model.
I will try to write back as soon as possible and help you clear up any doubts. I can also send you some additional screenshots if you need.

  - Please also contact me if there are any problems after purchase. We will try to solve the problem together ;)

  - To avoid misunderstandings this model is not intended for 3D printing.
It uses some low/mid-poly modeling tricks and is optimized for real-time and gaming apps and is an open mesh.
It is also intended primarily for rendering using various rendering engines (as Blender Cycles or Vray).

  - If you like this model and would like to make it printable please contact me first.
I'll try to make the model printable but I'll let you know if it is at all possible and what the differences will be.

description_text:
A cylindrical football stadium wiht stands and with official international measurements.
Field meassurements: 113m x 72.2m Penalty area/penalty box: 16.5m x 40.32m Penalty spot distance: 11m Goal: 7.32m
Includes; Stadium lights, scoreboard, grandstand with seats, team's bench, ball, cameras, goal, all countries flags, banners for adverts and banners for the top 60 national teams in the FIFA ranking.
The seats in the grandstands are as low poly as possible (4 faces) for optimal performance (game ready)
The field itself is composed of 24 modules that share 6 different textures of 1024x1024 px for each part of the field.
The standar texture size for the rest of the materials of the stadium is 512x512
The texture that contains all the flags is 1800x780 px
The** custom textures** for the banners are 312x512 px 740x560 px 256x256 px and 256x1024 px
Texture for the ball is 1024x1024 px
Texture for the scoreboard is 454x2160 px and contains every possible score from 0-0 to 99-99, includes time, 1st and 2nd half
All materials are PBR
*Export file formats are .fbx .obj .stl and .glb *
Project was made using blender 3.2
This stadium is part of a bigger** collection of 6 stadiums** and a** training field**. Certain elements like the textures and the field elements are shared across the entire collection.

Included File Formats
This model is provided in 14 widely supported formats, ensuring maximum compatibility:
• - FBX (.fbx) – Standard format for most 3D software and pipelines
• - OBJ + MTL (.obj, .mtl) – Wavefront format, widely used and compatible
• - STL (.stl) – Exported mesh geometry; may be suitable for 3D printing with adjustments
• - STEP (.step, .stp) – CAD format using NURBS surfaces
• - IGES (.iges, .igs) – Common format for CAD/CAM and engineering workflows (NURBS)
• - SAT (.sat) – ACIS solid model format (NURBS)
• - DAE (.dae) – Collada format for 3D applications and animations
• - glTF (.glb) – Modern, lightweight format for web, AR, and real-time engines
• - 3DS (.3ds) – Legacy format with broad software support
• - 3ds Max (.max) – Provided for 3ds Max users
• - Blender (.blend) – Provided for Blender users
• - SketchUp (.skp) – Compatible with all SketchUp versions
• - AutoCAD (.dwg) – Suitable for technical and architectural workflows

description_text:
PALMANOVABuilt in 1593 by the Republic of Venice, Palmanova is a fortress-city preserved in exemplary condition. A national monument since 1960, in 2017 it became part of the Unesco World Heritage on the transnational site Opere di difesa veneziane tra il XVI e il XVII secolo: Stato da Terra – Stato da Mar occidentale (Venetian Works of Defence between the 16th and 17th Centuries: Stato da Terra – Western Stato da Mar”).
A particular shapeWith its perfect nine-pointed star shape, monumental entrance gates and the three circles of fortifications from the 16th, 17th and 19th centuries, Palmanova is at the same time a model Renaissance city and an example of military architecture that reveals in concrete detail to the visitor the technical developments of the science of fortification construction in the modern era. The Piazza Grande, a large parade ground located in the exact centre of the fortress city, hosts the permanent exhibition Strumenti e macchine artificiose per costruire la fortezza di Palma (Instruments and artificial machines used to build the fortress of Palma) which reproduces in real dimensions some of the machines used to build Palmanova.
The historical re-enactmentOn the first weekend of September, Palmanova comes alive with the great historical re-enactment AD 1615. Palma alle armi (Palma at arms): over eight hundred reenactors in 17th century costume bring us back to the beginning of the war of the Uscocchi between Habsburg Austria and the Republic of Venice, to which Palmanova belonged until the fall of Venice (the “Serenissima”) to Napoleon in 1797.
PALMANOVA is a high quality model. Models possible to use in any project. Originally modelled in Blender 2.82 and 3ds max 2015. Final images rendered with Corona render 1.7
Model resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. All colors can be easily modified. Model is fully textured with all materials applied. No cleaning up necessary, just drop your models into the scene and start rendering. No special plugin needed to open scene.
File formats: -3ds Max 2015(.max), -OBJ (Multi Format), -3DS (Multi Format), -FBX (Multi Format), -blend (Blender 2.82) - Collada (dae )
If you need to make a model of any piece of land or city, write to us and we will fulfill your order
We would really appreciate if you could give positive rating, ratings are very important on CGTrader and it affect our reputation. If you have any problems with model/files please do not hesitate to contact us

description_text:
This collection package is made out of 15 different destroyed skyscrapers. This is very accurate scene of destroyed city. Designed for post nuclear themes with ruined architecture. Many details in scene. Ruined buildings, debris, cracked streets, street elements, simple cars, etc. This package provide you for create destroyed city. You can easy shift position of buildings or copy them to create even bigger city within minutes. Very easy to modify. All materials and textures included. An example scene is included in the package. It’s readily available to import in Unity3D and UE4.  Please Like and Rate! :)

Contains a set and a scene
Buildings Geometry: Polygons 1800, Vertices 2400 - Polygons 21500, Vertices 22000
15 Buildings Geometry: Polygons 261000, Vertices 277000
Scene Geometry: Polygons 648000, Vertices 711000 
Render Scene: Polygons  2460000,  Vertices  2670000

The set uses one texture and one material. The texture is made in substance painter.
2048x2048 png, pbr (Ambient occlusion, base color, height, metallic, normal, roughness)

Included 3D formats: blend, fbx, obj, dae

Modeled and textured in Blender.The model was initially created in Sketchup, in the year 2010, in a low-poly version (this Sketchup model is also included). Later, in the year 2023, the model has been completely redrawn, using Blender.
The viaduct of Ormaiztegi (situated in Gipuzkoa, Basque Country -Spain-) was built in the year 1863 according to a project of the engineer Alexander Lavalley. It has a length of nearly 300 meters and a maximum height of over 30 meters. The main body of it constitutes a drawer with a laminated steel structure consisting of three beams with 5.60 meters singing. It was strengthened by reinforced concrete towers interspersed between masonry in 1940. It has been part of the route of the railway line Madrid-Paris until after the year 1995 rail traffic has been diverted by a new viaduct built in their nearby.

description_text:
Based on the original blueprints, the S-profile, the wing twist, the arrow shape has been revised, so that the model behaves stable in the air without constructive blemishes, such as additional fins or thrust tube extensions.
Like the original, the model also has flaps on the wing tips as rudder. Due to the servo arrangement, the two flaps are controlled via only one radio channel (without additional programming work on the remote control) in such a way that, when actuated, e.g. to the left only the left side opens, while the right side remains unchanged.
In addition, the model can be equipped with a steerable retractable landing gear. 
With a bit of crafting experience and access to a CNC milling machine, the model can be easily recreated from commercially available foam panels.

description_text:
Low-poly historical accurate reconstruction of an portcullis mechanism for castle or town gates. A portcullis is a defense unit in ancient and medieval fortifications. It is usually made of heavy wood with metal covers on the outside. Sometimes it was used to smash or trap entering enemies, but usually it was closed even before an enemy would come close to the gate. The winch is operated by two handheld levers that have to be repositioned after each 1/4 turn. A metal latch prevents movable parts from unwinding during this process.
The file includes:

  - Gate house wall section including an upper level wooden floor

  - Wooden portcullis with metal fittings

  - Winch with lever, latching and rope

  - ONLY IN MAX-FILE: 2 animations (one falling portcullis and one for hoisting it back up)

Polys/Verts

  - Wall segment with gate and slits for the portcullis (312/328)

  - Wooden floor (818/864)

  - Winch with lever (836/940)

  - Portcullis (5,673/7,114)

  - Per rope (7,892/7,932)

Further Information
Models are:

  - Fully mapped and textured with PBR material (4k).

  - In real world scale (meters).

  - Logically grouped, layered, attached and named.

  - Animated (ONLY IN MAX-FILE)

Animations (ONLY IN MAX-FILE, as I could not find a suitable solution to export the rope’s path deform to any other format without breaking the animation of the rope. If you know a working solution for this problem, I would be happy to hear it):

  - falling / closing portcullis: frame 5 - 27

  - lifting / opening portcullis: frame 35 - 782

description_text:
Approximately 16.5 metres wide, 24.5m wide, and 5.5m tall (at the highest point). The shed is provided as multiple variants. The native Blender file is included with the object modifiers left unapplied (open_metal_shed_original.blend). Two zip files offer a high-poly version and low-poly version. The high poly version has all modifiers applied and is offered in many file formats. The low poly version has no modifiers and therefore has sharp edges and many of the parts are a single face thick.
Geometry:

  - All objects have been left separated to allow for easy modification.

  - Quads and tris with some planar ngons (they do not cause artifacts)

  - Not subdividable

  - Smooth shading with custom edge normal data (for some sharp edges)

  - Modelled to real-world scale, units: metres

  - Only parts of the mesh is watertight.

Texturing:

  - 6 basic PBR textures, color, normal, specular.

  - Resolutions: concrete: 2k, metal: 1k, screw and bolt: 1k.

  - png and jpg format

description_text:
Low poly house model.Oberlandesgericht Oldenburg Ausbildung in der niedersächsischen Justiz. Richten Sie Ihre Bewerbung an das Oberlandesgericht Oldenburg, Richard-Wagner-Platz 1, 26135 Oldenburg.
The building of the district court was built in the style of late historicism 1901-1902 under the direction of Adolf Rauchheld.The district court Oldenburg is a court of ordinary jurisdiction and one of eleven district courts in the district of the district court Oldenburg. Seat of the court is the district-free city of Oldenburg in Lower Saxony, the jurisdiction includes the district-free city of Oldenburg (Oldb.) And the communities Hatten, Hude (Oldb) and Wardenburg of the district of Oldenburg. The district court Oldenburg is superior to the district court Oldenburg competent higher regional court is the higher regional court Oldenburg. Both courts are located in the immediate vicinity of the district court in the Oldenburg district on Mühlenhunte.Здание окружного суда было построено в стиле позднего историзма 1901–1902 годов под руководством Адольфа Рауххельда.Окружной суд Ольденбурга является судом общей юрисдикции и одним из одиннадцати районных судов в районе окружного суда Ольденбурга. Местонахождение суда - безоконный город Ольденбург в Нижней Саксонии, юрисдикция включает безоконный город Ольденбург (Oldb.) И общины Хаттен, Худ (Oldb) и Варденбург округа Ольденбург. Окружной суд Ольденбурга является вышестоящим по отношению к окружному суду Ольденбурга. Компетентным высшим региональным судом является высший региональный суд Ольденбурга. Over the years, it has hosted many important events and civic functions, remaining a key local government hub. Today, it continues to serve as a venue for community events, council meetings, and public gatherings, reflecting Inverness's historical and cultural heritage.

description_text:
The Heroes Monument (Indonesian: Patung Pahlawan), popularly known as Tugu Tani is a bronze statue and important landmark located in Jakarta, Indonesia. The monument celebrates the heroes of the struggles of the Indonesian nation symbolized by a peasant youth wearing a caping with a rifle on his shoulder, a mother behind him offering him a dish of rice. The caping is a traditional farmer's hat in Indonesia, the statue is also referred as the Farmer's Monument (Patung Pak Tani or Tugu Tani).
The idea for the creation of the statue was initiated by Sukarno, the first president of Indonesia, when he visited Moscow in the late 1950s and was impressed with the statues in the city. He was introduced to a Socialist realist sculptor Matvey Manizer and his son Ossip Manizer.
-Modeling and sculpting using Blender

description_text:
All preview renders were rendered in Blender 2.8 using Cycles renderer with physically based Principled BSDF shader. Render setup utilizes 16384x8192 HDRI image lighting map (included).Textures are optimized for PBR rendering solutions (using Metalness or Specular workflows).Level 4 subdivision modifier is applied to geometry. Beauty renders uses albedo, roughness and vector displacement maps.
GEOMETRY

description_text:
This pack of alien cliffs contains 18 game-ready models of various mountain rocks. Provided meshes have the following resolution:
Note:At first glance, it might seem that there're too many polygons, but I made it so intentionally not to limit the use of models only to games. Each model has 5 levels of detail, so if you feel like the polycount is too high for your project, you don't have to leave it as is - start with LOD_1 and LOD_2. If you have any questions concerning the subject, don't hesitate to contact me.

  - Cliff_13: 50714 tris (25451 verts)

  - Cliff_14: 42317 tris (21246 verts)

  - Cliff_15: 43608 tris (21898 verts)

  - Cliff_16: 50651 tris (25452 verts)

  - Cliff_17: 43457 tris (21920 verts)

  - Cliff_18: 38476 tris (19407 verts)

Meshes

  - All meshes are low poly, and game ready. 

  - All models have 5 levels of detail.

  - Each model has its own texture set.

  - All of the models are without the bottom polygons.

Textures

  - Made with PBR using the Roughness/Metal workflow

  - DirectX normals

  - 4k and 2k texture pack provided

  - Textures should be assigned to materials in your 3d modeling program or game engine.

Scenes

  - Blender file with Eevee shader included (Eevee is a real-time render engine, after all, so you will have hints on how to set up material in any real-time engine)

  - Preview Images rendered in Eevee.

Contact me if you want me to make you mountains of a specific size, shape, and color.

description_text:
•        Let me present to you high-quality hi-poly smoothable 3D model of outdoor furniture Gandia Blasco Flat bar table. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc.. • All details of design are recreated most authentically.
•        The well topology of the model allows using any smoothing modifiers. Parts of this model you need to smooth in subdivision level 1 or 2 for the best result.
• The model is presented in tree size versions 50, 70 and 180 cm of length.
• Polygon count of non-smooth model 180 cm is – 7872, and with smooth level 2 – 125712. Other size versions have a lower polygon count.
•        The model uses 3 simple colored materials without textures: 2 for plastic and 1 for metal. 
•        The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
•        The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. Dimensions of real table is: 

  -   50 cm size: W50cm x D50cm x H105cm (W20” x D20” x H42” inches). 

  -   70 cm size: W70cm x D70cm x H105cm (W28” x D28” x H42” inches). 

  -   180 cm size: W180cm x D70cm x H105cm (W72” x D28” x H42” inches). All parts grouped and named correctly.

•        Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• In addition we have rendered this model in other scene with HDRI lighting for more visual realism demonstration and a better understanding of materials characteristics. HDRI scene is not included for sale.
•        To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).

High-quality low-poly 3D model of City Transport Bus. The interior part is also modeled,  and textured but with less detail.
This asset is best for use in a background of games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
It can also be rendered in Blender (ex Cycles) or Vray as the model is equipped with suited textures.
This asset was built with attention to detail and realistic proportions with the correct geometry.
We have also made every effort to ensure that these stylized textures are as detailed as possible and made with the greatest care.
Bonus Blender example scenes included (details are shown in the screenshots).  
Technical details:

  - 4096 x 4096 Diffuse and AO textures

  - 6526 Triangles

  - 3868 Polygons

  - 3840 Vertices

  - Model is correctly divided into main part and wheels.

  - Model completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

  - Pivot points are correctly placed to suit animation process.

  - Model scaled to approximate real world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials and textures are appropriately named.

Available file formats:

  - Blender 2.9 (.blend) (+ render scenes)

  - 3ds Max 2016 (.max)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - Unity3d 2017.3 (.unitypackage)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.gltf)

description_text:
Eddie Mauro™. Inti electric bus concept.  2012. Product and car design. Original file created in Autodesk Inventor. Interior seats are not included. Inti (Inca sun god) is a solar, urban / suburban electric bus. It was proposed for the master plan mobility and SITP in the form of inter-municipal transportation in the metropolitan area of Bogotá, in addition to possible uses within groups of complementary and urban buses. It was also proposed as an alternative a system of fair pay in which it was paid by the distance traveled by the passenger. Was focused in different topics of bus design such as: accessibility, lighting, indoor temperature, chairs, chairs organization and the atmosphere and interior appearance of the vehicle. All this adapted to the proposed payment system.
Team work with Crystian Hoyos.
More info here: https://www.behance.net/gallery/4955183/Inti-Electric-Solar-bus

description_text:
The lion and sun symbol you see on the model is the symbol of Iran. I will explain about itYou see the top of the scale model, which is a symbol of justice

  -  The size of the rim is 63 Europe and the weight of the model is 15.5 gr(gold18ky)

  -  Existing files: stl.obj.skp.fbx.3dm.3ds

The Lion and Sun (Persian: شیر و خورشید‎, romanized: Šir-o xoršid, pronounced [ˌʃiːɾo xoɾˈʃiːd]; Classical Persian: [ˌʃeːɾu xʷuɾˈʃeːd]) is one of the main emblems of Iran (Persia), and was an element in Iran's national flag until the 1979 Iranian Revolution. The motif, which illustrates ancient and modern Iranian traditions, became a popular symbol in Iran in the 12th century.The lion and sun symbol is based largely on astronomical and astrological configurations: the ancient sign of the sun in the house of Leo, which itself is traced back to Babylonian astrology and Near Eastern traditions.
The motif has many historical meanings. First, as a scientific and secular motif, it was only an astrological and zodiacal symbol. Under the Safavid and the first Qajar kings, it became more associated with Shia Islam. During the Safavid era, the lion and sun stood for the two pillars of society, the state and the Islamic religion. It became a national emblem during the Qajar era. In the 19th century, European visitors at the Qajar court attributed the lion and sun to remote antiquity; since then, it has acquired a nationalistic interpretation.During the reign of Fat′h-Ali Shah Qajar and his successors, the form of the motif was substantially changed. A crown was also placed on the top of the symbol to represent the monarchy. Beginning in the reign of Fat′h-Ali, the Islamic aspect of the monarchy was de-emphasized. This shift affected the symbolism of the emblem. The meaning of the symbol changed several times between the Qajar era and the 1979 revolution. The lion could be interpreted as a metaphor for the Shia Imam Ali or it could be symbolizing Rostam, the legendary hero of Iranian mythology. The Sun has alternately been interpreted as symbol of motherland or Jamshid, the mythical Shah of Iran. The many historical meanings of the emblem have provided rich ground for competing symbols of Iranian identity. In the 20th century, some politicians and scholars suggested that the emblem should be replaced by other symbols such as the Derafsh Kaviani. However, the emblem remained the official symbol of Iran until the 1979 revolution, when the Lion and Sun symbol was removed from public spaces and government organizations, and replaced by the present-day emblem of Iran.

description_text:
This model was originally designed for direct input into VRCHAT.
This pack has the Black & White version. Go check out the other versions and collect them all~!
It will require:

  - VRCSDK3-AVATAR-2021.09.30.16.19_Public or higher

  - Dynamic Bones v.1.2.2 or higher

  - Muscle Animation Editor v.2.2 or higher (not needed for export, but may cause errors when importing .unitypackage)

  - Xiexe's Unity Shaders Rewritten

IMPORTANT NOTES:
The package has many scenes, split into two sections per skin change.
The first section is the Hoverkitty variant. These has suffixes with the given cat breed, such as Black, Siamese, Tabby. They have dynamic bones for the paws, ears, and tail. This is compatible with Windows upload support.
The second section is the Hoverkitty Quest variant. These has suffixes with the given cat breed, such as Black, Siamese, Tabby. These ones do not have dynamic bones, as Android upload support prevents the use of then.
All scenes are identical, other than quest variants having no dynamic bones.
To import into VRCHAT:

  - Download the Hoverkitty.unitypackage [do not import yet]

  - Import the 4 packages for VRCSDK3, Dynamic Bones, Muscle Animation Editor (optional), Xiexe's Unity Shaders.

  - Import the Hoverkitty.unitypackage into your project.

  - Upload to VRCHAT using the Control Panel to Windows.

4a. (Quest) For Quest compatibility, there are extra scenes. Make sure to SWITCH BUILD TARGET TO ANDROID to upload.
sidenote. There are no blueprint ID's, so you will need to make your own, or upload via Windows or Android, and Unity will make one for you.sidenote.2 The prefabs being used for all objects are the beeg_hoverkitty variant, as the mesh is duplicated and not shared, rather than mirrored. This is to allow the calico texture to be asymmetrical.
With this avatar you are allowed to:

  - Redistribute with credit to SylviaCrisp

  - Use in private or public worlds

  - Use in private or public animations

  - Remesh any way you see fit

NOT ALLOWED:
  - Use in any violent or heinous way with credit to SylviaCrisp

description_text:
A railing ship, also known as a ship's rail or ship's railing, is a vital safety feature found on all types of ships and vessels. The railing serves as a protective barrier along the edges of decks and walkways, preventing individuals from accidentally falling overboard or into hazardous areas of the ship.
The primary purpose of a ship's railing is to ensure the safety of passengers, crew members, and any personnel on board. It provides a physical boundary that helps prevent accidental slips, trips, or falls from the ship's elevated surfaces. The railing acts as a guardrail, offering a secure handhold for individuals to steady themselves as they move around the ship.
Ship railings are typically made of sturdy materials such as stainless steel, aluminum, or other corrosion-resistant alloys. They are designed to withstand the harsh marine environment, including exposure to saltwater, wind, and waves. The height of the railing is regulated by maritime safety standards and varies depending on the type and size of the vessel.
In addition to its safety function, ship railings also have aesthetic and practical purposes. They contribute to the overall appearance of the ship, enhancing its sleek and professional look. Railings can be designed in various styles and finishes to match the vessel's overall design and architecture.
Furthermore, ship railings provide a practical support system for various shipboard activities. Passengers and crew members can lean on the railing while observing the surrounding views, participating in recreational activities, or simply enjoying the ocean breeze. The railing also serves as a mounting point for additional safety equipment such as lifebuoys, safety nets, and navigation lights.
Ship railings are subject to regular inspection and maintenance to ensure their integrity and functionality. Any damaged or corroded sections are promptly repaired or replaced to maintain the safety standards of the vessel. Periodic cleaning and polishing are performed to maintain the appearance and longevity of the railing materials.
In conclusion, the railing ship is an essential safety feature that plays a crucial role in preventing accidents and ensuring the well-being of individuals on board. It combines functionality, aesthetics, and regulatory compliance to provide a secure environment for passengers and crew members. Whether on a large cruise ship, cargo vessel, or small pleasure craft, ship railings are a fundamental component in promoting safe and enjoyable maritime experiences.

description_text:
Architecturally accurate model of Mesopotamian Ziggurat at the ancient city of Ur, in present day Iraq. Included is a simple human-size figure to give you the idea of the scale of this structure. Primarily used as a temple. In .max (3ds max 7) format.
About the file:
-Fully textured with bump, specular, and displacement maps. -No additional plugins required. -All textures included.
Originally created for a school project. After some careful compositing, my teacher, upon viewing the work, asked where we found that temple to shoot at. Didn't realize it was CG. Check out the previews.
In order to cut down on Polys, simply turn off MeshSmooth and Subdivide. You may have to turn off Displacement mapping also, as you may get strange artifacts after killing MeshSmooth. But then, it wont look as pretty and the individual bricks will be flat. But hey, its a trade-off.
All previews rendered in Max 7 with Mental Ray, with the exception of the clips captured from the final movie (composited using combustion).

description_text:
Designed in solidworks and keyshot
A Pirate is a type of German sailing dinghy. It was first constructed in 1935, and has no trapeze. The Pirate was designed in 1934 by the German boat builder Carl Martens. The boat was originally manufactured in solid wood, although since the 1960s glass-reinforced plastic, or a sandwich of the two, is also used. According to the regulations for this class of boat, kevlar and carbon fiber are forbidden. Approximately 6,000 boats have been built.[citation needed] The Pirate is a youth dinghy. It was formerly the only class used in German youth sailing championships. At present, the Pirate class is only registered in Germany. With more than 380 participants in the official rank list, it is one of the most active race classes in Germany. The Pirate is sailed by two persons, and measures 5.0 metres long by 1.6m across. The Pirate Class has also been used by the Royal Canadian Sea Cadets as a youth trainer. The maximum sail surface, comprising two sails, amounts to 10 m² according to the class regulations. Since the 1960s, spinnakers up to 10 m² are also permitted. The use of a Genoa or Gennaker is not permitted. The sails can be manufactured from cotton, linen or synthetic fabrics. Carbon fiber in the sails is forbidden, and may be used only as reinforcement in the windows of the sail

description_text:
Short overview.Japanese ya (arrow) set. Also usable for other asian regions and parts of europe.
Including17 types of authentic arrowheads.3 types of arrow shafts.6 colors of shaft structural ropeChoice between high and low poly arrows.
Over 300 arrow combinations possible.
Arrow shafts come in 3 types. These types are wood, bamboo and finally carbon black
The ropes come in red, purple, blue, black, white and light brown/natural rope.
detailed description
this set of Japanese arrows consists out different types of arrows that are historical used by Japanese hunters, warriors and samurai. archery was not just used for one purpose but was used for many different things. because of this, many different types of arrow heads were developed.
for example, some specific arrows were long, slender en light. these kind of arrows do not as much damage as arrows with larger heads but are much better at piercing light armor and tough hides, making them excellent for the many wars that japan waged . its also the type of arrow where the design reduced the amount of metal needed the most. Good steel used to be expensive in Japan after all.
a other example are the forked arrows. These are designed to hunt small animals and birds. because of their shape they have a higher chance to hit their target while also doing enough damage to catch them.
These models are based on real Edo period arrowheads that have been preserved.
Arrow heads are complete including the tang and can therefor be detached from the shaft. Perfect for animation scenes that show a breaking arrow or a assembly/maintenance scene.

description_text: Designed to create a spinning light displayaround room walls, this unit sits above most any incandescentlamp by way of a vertical center rod (supplied by user) that isfastened atop a lamp shade support. The lightfilter rotates as the rising heat from the light bulb passes upthrough its fan blades.  Lamp light shining up through the manyholes in the unit is scattered into a spinning array of light shapesthat dance across surrounding walls. Color canbe added to the light if transparent color film is added around theinterior circumference.  Tabs inside the circumference of the cylinder aredesigned to hold a 2" x 14.63" long ribbon of transparent color film,or lenses, for a variety of effects.  The model is designed tofit within a 5.5" cube of space to accommodate small 3-D printers. Of course, a printed model must be suspended at a sufficient distance from thebulb so that heat does not deform the thermo-plastic; user will have toexperiment for the optimum distance with the bulb wattage used.  A light gage coat hanger wire with a sharpenedtip is suggested for the central support rod.

description_text:
Real-time container model with PBR textures rendered from high-poly. Includes clean and dirty textures.
The containers feature realistic textures and wear, adding to their authenticity. This model is ideal for visualizing logistics scenarios, enhancing video game environments, or serving as a detailed asset in industrial design projects. The diverse colors and detailed markings make it a versatile and visually appealing addition to any digital scene.
The model is scaled correctly and has separate objects for moving parts. Also separate objects for the structure and panels.
Main project in .blend file includes a simple shader with properties for procedural ageing and color variation (custom properties in material).Also included custom masks to replicate the procedural ageing and color variation in other apps.
Everything is mapped to a single UV-Map with some overlap.
4k PBR textures included:Clean and aged versions forBaseColor;Metallic;Normal (OpenGL and DirectX);Roughness.
Extra textures included:Container_AgeMask.jpg for proceduraly mixing clean and aged look;Container_AO.jpg ambient occlusion;Container_ColorMask.jpg for procedural color variation;Container_Curvature.jpg curvature map rendered from high-poly model;Container_Id.jpg color-coded materials.
Model has: 33302 triangles13724 faces17799 vertices
Render scenes not included.

description_text:
Hi fellow maker,
This is a highly detailed 3D model ready to be 3D printed of the city of Chicago.
The area represented corresponds to approximately 20km2 in reality. The model was subsequently divided into 20 tiles each one measuring 15cm x 15cm. Once the print is finished you can finally combine all the sections together in order to create a fantastic 3d model of your favorite city.
A simple idea aimed at reducing the nostalgia resulting from the impossibility of being able to travel due to the restrictions from Covid-19; whether you decide to hang your original 3D city frame on the wall, place it on a table in your living room, display it in your office or give it to someone you care I hope that in contemplating it you too can feel at home again.
Happy printing, this is Chicago, Illinois.

Kingswear Castle in Devon, England, is an old coastal fortress overlooking the Dart Estuary. Built in the early 1500s during King Henry VIII's reign, it played a key role in defending England's coast. description_text:
The Wassily Chair, designed by Marcel Breuer in 1925, is a landmark of modern furniture design. Inspired by the streamlined aesthetic of bicycles, it features a tubular steel frame and taut leather or canvas seating. Created during Breuer’s time at the Bauhaus, the chair embodies the school's principles of functional design, industrial materials, and minimalist form.
The model is a high-poly model designed with CAD, so the measurements precisely fit the original chair. The leather straps have been carefully adjusted by hand to mimick the deformation caused by the weight of a person sitting. Metal frame has been carefully adjusted to emulate how the real metal frame after fabrication would look like (e.g. slightly squashed on the elbow of the pipes caused by the bending process.) And many more details. 
I've used this model myself for architectural vizualizations. Due to being modelled even to the last detail, it is perfect for close-up shots where you can see the material and the structure more closely.
This model was made in Blender. The original blender file has the node materials you see on the images.

Embark on a visual journey with these meticulously crafted PBR (Physically Based Rendering) models, ready for immediate use in game development, particularly within the Unreal Engine. Inspired by Ridley Scott's iconic Alien franchise, this collection features procedurally generated rock formations entwined with sinuous vines or tentacles, creating a captivating alien landscape that blurs the boundaries between reality and the extraterrestrial unknown.
Built with Houdini's procedural generation, these assets showcase a seamless blend of technical artistry and aesthetic finesse. Each element is optimized for PBR workflows, ensuring realistic material rendering and effortless integration into game environments. The Alien Landscape Environment is designed to enhance the visual storytelling of your projects, offering a cinematic touch that suits a range of applications.
Perfect for game developers, filmmakers, and digital artists, these PBR models are compatible with Unreal Engine, providing a hassle-free integration process. Elevate your projects with ease, as these assets are crafted for immediate use, saving you valuable production time.
